notes.title: Sleeve Shock - May Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340269/c358f4eed14e09bde584833af4892856360aa655.jpg[/img]

It's the Sleeve Shock May Update!
Our main character, and Robie go out on their first mission undercover as party goers to try and run a simple heist, but everything goes wrong!
We get to meet a new character, and there's been a big music overhaul!

notes.title: Sleeve Shock - April Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340269/0257b75459d5082db914ae115d79d48d015e7b68.jpg[/img]

Robie needs your help to adjust her body to fit in better for the upcoming mission, but does it go according to plan?

notes.title: Sleeve Shock - March Update! New Animations added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340269/d334e8b4b3e76e9de37059d1846d43d6633769d0.jpg[/img]

It's the Sleeve Shock March Update!

However! this update is special because it marks a space that almost all of the sexy scenes are animated!

And also going forwards all the new scenes will be animated. This game has been developing really well and we've been enjoying how it's all been coming together, the story is really starting to get punchy, the character scenes come across so hot, thanks to our super talented art team!

Stay tuned for next month's update, as we've got something special planned.

Well Robie hints towards it in the game, so you'll just have to read through and listen.

notes.title: Sleeve Shock - February Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340269/2de17427ef3a251a1d147711e805a8619979c1a9.jpg[/img]

Sleeve Shock's February update comes with the first batch of animated scenes being added into the game!

The city has gone on lockdown for a huge corpo operation right as you visit Robie's apartment. Will you all be able to keep it together long, while stuck together?

Introducing the game's first mini-game as the MC is being taught how to crack a safe for an upcoming heist job!

notes.title: Sleeve Shock - December Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340269/c5e1615ead58a4a5851c3d1468c0f4650b478b25.jpg[/img]



The game now has a gallery implemented, and a continuation of last months heart-string tugging arc!

We're finally wrapping up on some bigs things, before we start to head out to some new locations and meet some new characters, now that the initial panic is settling, and their bounties are cleared, it's time to stat doing some jobs!​

notes.title: Sleeve Shock May Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340269/fca2901ba78402baa8821961e5ab00e6edf0596b.jpg[/img]

It's May update time for Sleeve Shock!

Robie's just gotten her own apartment, are you going to stick around to help her break it in?

This update marks the beginning of the Robie route, but rather than continue to focus on one character future updates will flick back and forth between the different routes.

notes.title: Sleeve Shock - March Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340269/d82e8d545d91e5d123ce84034bb24c11812917d3.jpg[/img]
The crew have all gone on an important job, and left Robie to babysit you. Surely you'll just have a nice chat, right? Maybe play a boardgame?


In other news, all of the THM Studios games, now update on a schedule (It's been like this for a little while, but more announcing it as we've been sticking to it.) Where Sleeve Shock will always update on the first Monday of the month (AEST), with our other games updating on the other Mondays. So always keep your eye open for new content at the start of the week!

notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44340269/40b3f368c045d6326c9f3945d51469da4600f87a.jpg[/img]

It's the end of the intro!
This release is another burst of story content, that ends where it does because that's the end of the intro arc!
Next update will include a navigable map, that will make future scenes more modular instead of linear! (So we kinda had to end it here so you don't get half a map implemented) 

Changelog:
-Added intro cards to explain some lore and concepts in the game
-Conclusion of shower drama
-New Expressions added
-Ann Muscles reveal
